if: the option under s.17(4) has been exercised for a financial year
the registered person seeks to withdraw it before the end of that financial year
then: withdrawal is NOT PERMITTED for the remaining part of that financial year
note: The lock runs to the end of the financial year, not for twelve months from the election. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: Provided that the option once exercised shall not be withdrawn during the remaining part of the financial year:
